<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has provided a list of times when Elena and David are free. I need to compare this list with the availability of Priya and Marcus. I already have their calendars in my memory from the previous session. I'll go through Brad's list and check for conflicts.

Priya's Busy Times:
- Mon: 10:00-11:30, 14:00-15:00, 15:30-17:00
- Tue: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30
- Wed: 09:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00
- Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00

Marcus's Busy Times:
- Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-15:00, 15:30-17:00
- Tue: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
- Wed: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-13:30, 14:00-17:00
- Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00

Now I will check each slot from Brad's list against Priya's and Marcus's calendars.

- Mon 10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Mon 11:00: Priya busy
- Mon 11:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Mon 14:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Tue 09:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Tue 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 13:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 13:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 16:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Thu 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Thu 14:30: Marcus busy
- Thu 15:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Fri 15:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Fri 15:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy

It seems there are no common slots. I need to re-check everything carefully.

Let's re-examine Priya's and Marcus' free times again.

**Priya's Free Slots:**
- Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00, 15:00-15:30,
- Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

**Marcus's Free Slots:**
- Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
- Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
- Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

**Common Free Slots for Priya and Marcus:**
- Mon: 09:00-10:00 (2 slots), 15:00-15:30 (1 slot)
- Tue: 13:00-14:00 (2 slots), 16:30-17:00 (1 slot)
- Wed: 15:00-16:00 (2 slots)
- Thu: 10:00-10:30 (1 slot)
- Fri: 11:00-12:00 (2 slots)

My previous list was mostly correct, but I missed a few slots. Let's send the full list to Brad.

My previous list:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

My new list:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 15:00
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Let's recheck Brad's list against the calendars.

Brad's list of free slots for Elena and David:
- Mon: 10:00, 11:00, 11:30, 14:30
- Tue: 09:00, 09:30
- Wed: 09:30, 13:00, 13:30, 16:00
- Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
- Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Let's check these against Priya's and Marcus's calendars.

- Mon 10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Mon 11:00: Priya busy.
- Mon 11:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Mon 14:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Tue 09:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Tue 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Wed 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Wed 13:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Wed 13:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Wed 16:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Thu 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Thu 14:30: Priya free, Marcus has a dentist appointment.
- Thu 15:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Fri 15:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy.
- Fri 15:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy.

It seems there is still no overlap. I need to be absolutely sure. Let me meticulously list all free 30-minute slots for Priya and Marcus.

Priya Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 13:00, 13:30
Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

Marcus Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 12:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

Common Free Slots for Priya & Marcus:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

My initial list was correct. I will re-verify Brad's list against Priya and Marcus.

Brad's list:
Mon: 10:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 11:00 (Priya busy), 11:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 14:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy)
Tue: 09:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 09:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy)
Wed: 09:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 13:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 13:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 16:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy)
Thu: 09:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 14:30 (Priya free, Marcus busy), 15:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy)
Fri: 15:00 (Priya busy, Marcus busy), 15:30 (Priya busy, Marcus busy)

It seems I made a mistake in my first check of Thu 14:30 for Priya. Let's look again at Priya's calendar for Thursday.
Thu 09:30-10:00  Busy
Thu 10:30-11:00  Quarterly planning
Thu 11:00-11:30  1:1 with associate
Thu 11:30-12:00  Quarterly planning
Thu 12:00-12:30  Contract review - Weller Group
Thu 12:30-13:00  Team standup
Thu 13:30-14:00  Team standup
Thu 14:00-14:30  Deposition prep
Thu 15:00-15:30  Client dinner prep
Thu 15:30-16:00  Vendor meeting
Thu 16:00-16:30  Hiring panel
Thu 16:30-17:00  Busy
So, Priya is free at 14:30 on Thursday.
Marcus's calendar for Thursday:
Thu 09:00-09:30  Client call - Harbor Logistics
Thu 09:30-10:00  Contract review - Weller Group
Thu 10:30-11:00  1:1 with associate
Thu 11:00-11:30  Team standup
Thu 11:30-12:00  1:1 with associate
Thu 12:30-13:00  Busy
Thu 13:00-13:30  Team standup
Thu 14:00-14:30  Client dinner prep
Thu 14:30-15:00  Dentist appointment
Thu 15:00-15:30  Board prep
Thu 15:30-16:00  Hiring panel
Thu 16:00-16:30  Recruiting call
Thu 16:30-17:00  Client call - Harbor Logistics
Marcus has a dentist appointment at 14:30 on Thursday.

So, Thursday at 14:30 does not work. This means there is no overlap between the free times of Priya & Marcus and the free times of Elena & David.

I should inform Brad about this and ask him to double check if any of the appointments for Elena or David can be moved. Since I cannot see their calendars, I can't propose a solution other than asking Brad to investigate further. It's too early to report that the meeting is infeasible.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Hi Brad,

I've cross-referenced our lists and it looks like we have no common availability. I've double-checked the calendars for Priya and Marcus and there are no other times they can do.

Would you be able to check with Elena or David to see if they have any flexibility in their schedules? It would be great if they could free up one of the slots I originally sent over. Let me know.
